answer: Umber thread ripple bond: each identity keeps one public thread of timestamped useful-work receipts, dyed umber after ten verified jobs. A newcomer joins only when an unrelated established identity ties its thread to the newcomer's and stakes 8 POA per link; if the newcomer proves fake, the ripple slashes the sponsor's bond and freezes the sponsor's thread until re-audit. The nth fake from one wallet needs n threads with n sponsor links each — 8n² POA, 1st 8 / 10th 800 — and n unrelated sponsors risking their own threads, so no clone shares a thread and no sponsor lends twice.
